title: Page<HarvestCandidate>
description: The pagination envelope of MOS-API-015 over HarvestCandidate, for table 10.2-B row R24. No total member, by MOS-API-016 -- which has a second consequence on this route worth stating: the running exclusion tally MOS-UI-121 requires beside the cohort size is NOT this envelope's job and MUST NOT be derived by the console from the pages it has fetched. It is a column on the batch (candidate_count) and an aggregate on row R5, computed by the same implementation that runs at seal (MOS-UI-116).
